adjudication.depicted_input: Architecture crop showing paired DNA sequences processed through Evo2 and a learnable projection into DNA embeddings, alongside tokenized text-query embeddings and special tokens, all stacked as the BIOREASON/Qwen3 model input.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible under the atlas rules because it clearly shows the actual model-input construction: DNA-derived embeddings, tokenized text-query embeddings, and their stacking into the combined input representation. The model box itself is not required when the route-specific input representation is visible. This shared architecture figure validly supports all listed fine-tuning routes because they use the same depicted DNA-plus-text input mechanism.
